megalith_1 = {
	type_icon = "duchy_buildings/megalith.dds"
	next_building = megalith_2
	cost_gold = regular_building_cost_tier_1
	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	district_level_requirement = {
        value = 2
        if = { limit = { has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active } value = 0 }
    }
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		scope:holder.rite = {
			rite_has_parameter = can_build_megaliths
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	is_enabled = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = province_is_of_a_megalith_faith_tt
			county.rite = { rite_has_parameter = can_build_megaliths }
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	character_modifier = {
		monthly_piety = poor_building_tax_tier_1
	}
	county_modifier = {
		monthly_popular_opinion_change = regular_building_popular_opinion_growth_tier_1
		prosperity_growth_factor = 0.02
	}
	character_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_mandala
		monthly_piety = 0.01
	}
	on_complete = {
		mandala_built_piety_building_effect = yes
	}
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_general_building_modifier = yes
		ai_pious_building_preference_modifier = yes
		ai_capital_preference_modifier = yes
		ai_holding_district_building_modifier = { LEVEL = 1 }
	}
}

            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		scope:holder.rite = {
			rite_has_parameter = can_build_megaliths
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	is_enabled = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = province_is_of_a_megalith_faith_tt
			county.rite = { rite_has_parameter = can_build_megaliths }
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	character_modifier = {
		monthly_piety = poor_building_tax_tier_4
	}
	county_modifier = {
		monthly_popular_opinion_change = regular_building_popular_opinion_growth_tier_4
		prosperity_growth_factor = 0.08
	}
	character_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_mandala
		monthly_piety = 0.02
	}
	on_complete = {
		mandala_built_piety_building_effect = yes
	}
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_general_building_modifier = yes
		ai_pious_building_preference_modifier = yes
		ai_capital_preference_modifier = yes
		ai_holding_district_building_modifier = { LEVEL = 4 }
	}
}
